title: Numerical methods for diffusion coefficient recovery
summary: We revisit the inverse problem of reconstructing a spatially varying diffusion coefficient in stationary elliptic equations from boundary Cauchy data. From a theoretical perspective, we introduce a gradient-weighted modification of the coupled complex-boundary method (CCBM) incorporating an \(H^1\)-type term, and formulate the reconstruction as a regularized optimization problem over bounded admissible coefficients.
